description: This file defines synchronization utilities for a C++ project, including thread-local flags, template-based lock management, and functions for registering API methods with locking mechanisms. It facilitates thread-safe API calls and plugin communication within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct that maintains a static recursive mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API access.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that unlocks the API mutex upon construction if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex, providing explicit lock and unlock methods.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function wrapper around a class method, ensuring thread-safe invocation with locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a class method as a JSON-RPC method with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a class method with versioning support for JSON-RPC, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a class method with a JSONRPC handler, ensuring thread safety.
